name: Elisabetha Margaretha Lampert

events.title: Baptism
events.description: 'Eodem die' after an entry of 17 Dec: Abraham Lamperti of Jettenbach and his wife Maria Sara had a daughter Elisabetha Margretha baptized. Godparents include 'Conrad, Hans Peter Gruben ehelicher Sohn zu Jettenbach' (her future husband's half-brother), plus women of Jettenbach, Niederstaufenbach and Kollweiler.

bioAdditions: Round 4 read her baptism in the Reichenbach Lutheran register (S1). On 17 Dec 1702 Abraham Lamperti of Jettenbach and his wife Maria Sara had their daughter Elisabetha Margretha baptized, five days after the 12 Dec birth on the site. Among the godparents was Conrad, son of Hans Peter Grub of Jettenbach, so the two families were close long before her marriage to Nickel Grub in 1720. The entry names her mother only as Maria Sara. FamilySearch identifies her as Maria Sara Jung (c.1678-before 1721), daughter of Paul Jung and Maria Barbara, and earlier the widow of Johann Philipp Wirth, and dates her marriage to Abraham at Glan-Münchweiler to 6 Oct 1699 (S2). FamilySearch gives Elisabetha Margaretha's death as 8 May 1749 at Jettenbach, with burial the next day (S2).

confidenceRecommendation.justification: Baptism (parents) read in the register; her marriage and children are documented in the existing file.
